description: This file defines structures and functions for parsing and representing RAID device status information from /proc/mdstat, including classes for MDStat and MDStatComponent, and parsing logic for RAID states, recovery, and component devices.

classes.name: MDStatComponent
classes.description: Represents a component device in a RAID array, including flags such as Faulty, Spare, Journal, etc.

classes.name: MDStat
classes.description: Holds parsed RAID device status information including name, type, activity state, disk counts, sync progress, speed, and component devices.

methods.name: FS.MDStat
methods.description: Reads and parses /proc/mdstat to return a slice of MDStat objects representing RAID device statuses.

methods.name: parseMDStat
methods.description: Parses the byte data from /proc/mdstat and returns a slice of MDStat objects with detailed RAID info.

methods.name: evalStatusLine
methods.description: Evaluates a status line to extract active, total, down disks, and size.

methods.name: evalRecoveryLine
methods.description: Parses a recovery line to extract sync progress, percentage, estimated finish time, and speed.

methods.name: evalComponentDevices
methods.description: Parses component device fields to create MDStatComponent objects with flags.

methods.name: isRaidType
methods.description: Determines if a string matches a known RAID type and is not formatted like a device name.
